amendment_label: blinded during-collection implementation amendment: written after the Q357 window opened at 18:35 UTC with no capture data read; not a pre-window freeze

analysis_plan.admission: only after the declared Q357 close and a terminal supervisor; the pairing plan chain is authenticated before the first capture read; the live-v1 checks run in a child under the same hard limits; the seal is written once, admitted or unavailable
analysis_plan.capital: negative chronological minimum of each episode's cash prefix, unlimited prefunding convention; per episode only, never a portfolio sum
analysis_plan.claims: displayed conditional evaluation of causally reachable states; no fill, executability, USD, collateral identity or profit claim; work caps are unknown, never negative
analysis_plan.entry: one global episode per maximal qualifying entry interval for each route and fee schedule; episode state changes restart only that episode's closure gates; an all-miss attempt with no state change cannot retry until its predicate is false then true
analysis_plan.fees: one schedule per replay with 0 <= f <= 1 and conversion fees >= 0; schedules enter every gate; zero fees optimistic; no component repricing
analysis_plan.gates: maximal half-open intervals of a continuously true predicate (key, support, economic test), evaluated at frames, liveness expiries and the episode's own state changes; qualification at start + 1000 ms strictly before the end; one evaluation per interval at qualification + 500 ms on the causal state only; frames at an instant precede evaluation; e = min(censoring stop, invalidation, window close) blocks any evaluation at or after it
analysis_plan.kernel: isolated decorated copy of the pinned live-v1 replay; its undecorated output must equal the unchanged kernel on the same records or the run is refused; added outputs: per-mark usable view, accepted source time and receipt time per coin
analysis_plan.rates: exact only for a complete scan without unbuilt overflow; unbuilt overflow has unknown size admission, so its rate pairs are conservative bounds that may be undefined; an incomplete scan makes every full-window rate unavailable and labels any prefix rates prefix_only, never a full-window result
analysis_plan.retention: at most MAX_EPISODES episode objects per route and schedule; later decisions are counted as unbuilt work_cap without allocation; each episode is reconciled and tallied as it ends; the trace keeps an exact encoded prefix within its role share; failed runs keep their bounded staged outputs renamed not-admitted-* beside an unavailable receipt
analysis_plan.units: conditional one-token granularity: displayed sizes floored to whole tokens for m and fills; admission needs integer m >= 1; quote-token cash only

bounds.measured: in-memory stress synthetics with the named bid sum near 1, each in a forked child under RLIMIT_AS 4 GiB: 364,291 records, primary 28.0M steps, 96 s CPU, 1.62 GB peak RSS; sensitivity 6.9M steps, 76 s CPU; MAX_STEPS at about 1.7 us per step plus the kernel replay is about 315 s, inside the CPU limit

claims: displayed conditional evaluation only; quote-token units; zero fees optimistic; no fill, executability, USD or profit claim; episode sums overlap and are never portfolio cash; caps are unknown, never negative

denominators.closure_within_window: (entry_closed + closed) / (filled + work_cap); upper adds censored_open, invalidated_open and work_cap
denominators.decision_to_fill: filled / (decisions - not_admitted_size - entry_censored); upper adds work_cap
denominators.decisions: qualifying entry intervals per route and schedule; null if the step cap ends the entry scan

note: fee sensitivity at three arbitrary predeclared points; separate replay, never pooled with the primary

predeclaration.failure: no closed episode with v > 0 among complete decisions; a negative for this window and policy only
predeclaration.fixed_input: only the closed Q357 live-v1 capture, admitted locally by --admit with the reviewed live-v1 gates and sealed in q357-input-seal-v1.json; no other data
predeclaration.question: Within the frozen Q357 window, do displayed, causally reachable, supported states admit funded forward-first or named-only inverse-first episodes, and how do they end?
predeclaration.success: candidate_conditional: at least one closed or entry_closed episode with v > 0; reported with every class, rate pair, capital and age, never as fill, executability or profit
predeclaration.unavailable: admission fails, the seal is unavailable, any hard limit or refusal ends the run, or a cap leaves decisions null; never converted to a negative

supersession_reason: v6 consistency fix: every redundant declared bound (bounds, category shares, question, predeclared costs and limits) is generated from the enforced constants and verified exactly, replacing stale draft-derived bounds (20M steps, 512 episodes, category-total outputs, 150,291-record timing); v5 rationale: a full-scale stress synthetic showed the 20M step cap could end the scan on a busy window; v5 caches each episode closure-gate terms between state changes and holds one exact decimal context per scan (outputs byte-identical to v4 by pairing-equivalence-v5) and raises MAX_STEPS to 150M inside the unchanged CPU 600 s, RAM 4 GiB, wall 900 s and output caps; no economic rule, gate, fee point, decision cap or claim changed
